profileEvidence.author: A
profileEvidence.summary: Playful, affectionate and eager to learn, the Cavador often enjoys being close to its people and joining a game of ball. This Labrador–Cavalier cross can combine an active, sociable manner with quieter time beside the family. An alert bark may announce unfamiliar visitors. The name covers first crosses and later matings with either parent, so adult size and coat can vary.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Sociable and playful, Cavadors often enjoy company, ball games and learning, with adult size and coat varying across this cross.
